content.body: Floodlit pitch slots are limited between November and February. The committee has agreed to rotate the existing allocation between the under-13 and under-15 groups rather than fixing it to one group for the season. Coaches will be notified of their allocation by 15 October.

No photograph or video of a player may be published on any club channel without a photo consent record on file. Consent is recorded at registration and may be withdrawn at any time by written notice to the club secretary, taking effect within five working days.

Any player who sustains a head impact is removed from play immediately and may not return the same day. Return to play requires written clearance. All coaches must record the incident in the session log within 24 hours.
